description.value: Caffe Divano Port Moody is a community-oriented café nestled in the Klahanie neighbourhood, a short walk from Rocky Point Park and connected to St. John's Street via a pedestrian overpass. It was the founding location of the Divano family of cafés, opened in 2008 by Patrick and Lisa Beecroft with a vision of a true neighbourhood gathering spot decorated with local art. All baked goods are sourced from the Beecrofts' sister business, Gabi & Jules Handmade Pies & Baked Goodness, which also employs individuals with autism.
